Container.Name: letopis
Container.Overview: Letopis is an idle civilization simulation that lives on its own. A few families start in the Stone Age and discover fire, tools, farming and everything after without anyone pressing a button. Open the web page whenever you like to see how far they got. English and Bulgarian.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The world lives here: world.json.gz, the chronicle (SQLite) and the archive of old worlds

Config.Name: Speed (testing only)
Config.Description: 1 = normal (about 3 months to the present day). A bigger number speeds the world up, for testing only.
